headline: Million Dollar contract awards for Allegiance Fire & Rescue and sanitary equipment, and a $900,000 bond for a 14 Mulberry Street resource center.
summary: The agenda includes final approval of a 2026 Kenworth T280 service truck and a request to convene a Joint Committee on Infrastructure and Fire Commission. A Harbor Homes grant change and a federal bridge project agreement with the State and Town of Hudson are on the list too.
items: Request to convene a Joint Committee on Infrastructure and Fire Commission
Million Dollar Contract Award to Allegiance Fire & Rescue
Million Dollar Contract Award for Sanitary Equipment
Budget Review Committee reports from 10/6/26 and 10/26/26
Resolution R-26-080 to amend Section 7 of the Harbor Homes agreement for transitional and permanent housing for non-veterans and their families
Resolution R-26-020 authorizing up to $900,000 in bonds for a resource center at 14 Mulberry Street

Resolution R-26-081 authorizing a federal Bridge Aid agreement with the State and the Town of Hudson to rehabilitate the Taylor Falls and Veterans Bridges, and a reimbursement agreement with the Town of Hudson
item_action_words: Human Affairs Committee with recommendation for final passage
tabled at Special Board of Aldermen meeting on 4/22/26
